$note: A Stop hook is a safety net, not a judge -- Claude Code ends the turn after eight consecutive blocks, so a hook that keeps failing stops blocking. CI is the judge. The gate runs under .venv/bin/python because the pinned interpreter on this machine has no pytest and a hook that cannot run is worse than no hook: it reports green by saying nothing. A fresh worktree has no .venv of its own, so link one before relying on the hook there: ln -s ../../../.venv .venv. The plain-name check tests for its own file first, so it stays silent until that module lands rather than printing an import error on every edit.
